how_to_use: Plan with these SkillNodes. Each node is one verb + one noun; fill the typed inputs, check the preconditions you can see, and chain nodes through their relations. The executor verifies every pre/postcondition on ground-truth simulator state and returns measured facts and fallback candidates on failure.

all_inside.meaning: Every listed object is inside the container.

arm_stowed.meaning: The arm is folded at its travel posture.

at_initial_place.meaning: Object is back on the support it occupied when the episode started.

away_from_edge.meaning: Object footprint at least the margin inside every edge of its support.

base_clear_of.meaning: Base centre at least the given distance from the place's footprint.

base_near.meaning: Base centre within 1.3 m of the place's footprint (inside the room for a room).

button_pressed.meaning: A measured press of this button happened during the Contract.

clustered.meaning: Every listed object's footprint centre lies within the radius of the group centroid, on one support.

container_empty.meaning: No annotated object is inside the container.

counted.meaning: The robot recorded how many objects of the category it sees from its current place.

covered.meaning: The lid rests centred on the container rim (3 cm xy, 3 cm height, 12 deg tilt).

dipped.meaning: A held utensil tip entered the container below its rim and came back out.

edge_overhang.meaning: A flat object overhangs a support edge enough for an edge pinch (>= 5.5 cm) while its centre of mass stays 3.5 cm inside the edge.

facing.meaning: Base heading within 20 deg of the target bearing.

flipped.meaning: Object's local z axis now points opposite to its direction at the start (dot <= -0.7).

grasp_clearance.meaning: Some annotated pinch of the object has both finger slots (2.8 x 1.2 cm, at the pre-grasp opening) free of neighbours; objects without a pinch need 3.5 cm of free footprint gap.

grouped.meaning: Every listed object is on the support and pairwise within the distance.

heating.meaning: The appliance's heat source is on (microwave cycle or stove burner).

held_above.meaning: Right-held object's bottom at or above the given world height (2 cm tolerance).

held_below.meaning: Right-held object's bottom at or below the given world height (2 cm tolerance).

hidden.meaning: Object is inside a lid-covered container or on a shelf inside a closed cabinet.

holding.meaning: The object is in the given gripper: fingers not shut, TCP-to-body distance unchanged since the grasp.

hovering_over.meaning: The right-held object's bottom is 3-15 cm above the target's top, centred within 4 cm.

identified.meaning: The robot recorded the object's category while it was in the head camera view.

in_appliance.meaning: Object centre inside the appliance cavity box (microwave) or body box (refrigerator).

in_cookware_on_burner.meaning: Food is inside a container whose bottom rests on the stove burner disc (or on the disc itself).

in_view.meaning: Target point inside the head camera frustum, within 5 m, line of sight not blocked by furniture boxes.

inside.meaning: Object centre inside the container's wall profile, between its floor and 3 cm above the rim.

is_closed.meaning: Joint within 0.10 rad (doors) or 4 cm (drawers) of closed.

is_open.meaning: Joint at least 60 % of the way from closed to its annotated open value.

knocked.meaning: Two measured fingertip contacts on the closed panel during the Contract; the joint moved < 0.05.

lying.meaning: Object on its side: longest axis within 60 deg of horizontal and vertical extent <= 60 % of its length.

measured.meaning: The robot recorded the object's size from a view with the object in the head camera.

moved_toward_base.meaning: Object's horizontal distance to the base decreased by at least half the requested distance.

nodded.meaning: The head performed a measured nod (>= 2 pitch cycles of >= 0.2 rad).

object_moved.meaning: Object displaced along the direction by at least half the requested distance.

object_rolled.meaning: Object rotated at least 45 deg about a horizontal axis while staying on its side.

observed.meaning: The robot saw the target in its head camera during this episode (set by look, search, inspect, explore).

on.meaning: Object bottom within -2..+5 cm of the support height with its centre over the support box.

on_burner.meaning: Object bottom on the stove's burner disc (3 cm radial and height tolerance).

on_top_of.meaning: Object rests on the base object's top face: bottom within 2 cm of it, centre over its footprint.

pointing_at.meaning: The right finger axis points at the target within 8 deg.

positions_swapped.meaning: Each object now rests within 6 cm of the other's starting position on its starting support.

poured_into.meaning: At least half of the items that were inside the source are now inside the target.

presenting.meaning: The right-held object is in front of the body at 0.9-1.4 m height and in the head camera view.

reachable.meaning: From the current base pose the right TCP has a collision-free IK solution 10 cm above the target (handle pre-grasp for doors, 8 cm in front of a button).

room_explored.meaning: At least 75 % of the room's head-camera viewpoints were covered.

shaken.meaning: The held object was oscillated at least three times with >= 2 cm amplitude without slipping.

sidestepped.meaning: Base moved sideways by the signed distance (left > 0) within 3 cm, heading unchanged within 3 deg.

sorted_by_category.meaning: Each listed object is inside the container (or on the support) mapped to one of its tags.

squared.meaning: Object yaw within 5 deg of the support's axes (edges parallel), resting on a support.

steadied.meaning: The left gripper pinches the object while it still rests on its support.

stirred.meaning: A held utensil tip completed one full circle inside the container below its rim.

support_clear.meaning: No annotated object rests on the support.

temperature_at_least.meaning: Task-level food temperature at or above the threshold.

temperature_at_most.meaning: Task-level food temperature at or below the threshold.

top_clear.meaning: No other object rests on the object's top face.

torso_at.meaning: Torso lift joint within 2 cm of the requested position (0 = top, -0.54 = bottom).

torso_lowered.meaning: Torso lift within 3 cm of its lowest position (floor reach).

torso_raised.meaning: Torso lift within 3 cm of its highest position (travel height).

touched.meaning: A measured fingertip contact with the object's top during the Contract; it moved < 1.5 cm.

uncovered.meaning: No lid rests on the container rim.

upright.meaning: Object z axis within 20 deg of vertical.

waist_bent.meaning: Waist pitched forward by at least the given angle.

waist_straight.meaning: Waist pitch within 0.05 rad of upright.

waited.meaning: At least the given simulated time passed during the Contract.

waved.meaning: The right hand performed a measured wave (>= 2 lateral swings at head height).

wiped.meaning: A held wiping tool stayed in contact with at least 50 % of the requested strip of the support.

yaw_rotated.meaning: Object yaw changed by the requested angle within 10 deg.
